title: AINM Protocol - Agent Card Schema
description: JSON Schema for AINM Agent Cards. A2A-compatible superset with AINM extensions under the ainm namespace. See agent-card.md.

AgentCapabilities.description: A2A-compatible capabilities object declaring high-level agent features. See agent-card.md Section 5.2.

streaming.description: Whether the agent supports streaming responses.

pushNotifications.description: Whether the agent supports push notifications for asynchronous task updates.

AgentSkill.description: A named capability or area of expertise the agent can perform. See agent-card.md Section 5.3.

id.description: Unique identifier for the skill within this Agent Card. Alphanumeric with hyphens.

description.description: Detailed description of what the skill does.

tags.description: Categorization tags for search and filtering.

AgentTool.description: A discrete function an agent can invoke. Exposed in the ainm.tools array with name, description, and JSON Schema input. See agent-card.md Section 6.2.

name.description: Tool name. MUST be unique within the ainm.tools array. Alphanumeric with underscores and hyphens.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the tool does.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) describing the tool's input parameters. MUST be a valid JSON Schema object with type: 'object'.

AINMStreamingCapability.description: AINM-specific streaming capability details. See agent-card.md Section 6.2.

supported.description: Whether the agent supports AINM streaming (start/delta/end lifecycle).

parallelBlocks.description: Whether the agent can stream into multiple content blocks simultaneously.

preferredChunkSize.description: Preferred delta granularity. 'token' = lowest latency, 'sentence' = fewer events.

AINMThreadingCapability.description: AINM-specific threading capability details. See agent-card.md Section 6.2.

subThreads.description: Whether the agent supports participating in sub-threads.

maxConcurrentThreads.description: Maximum concurrent threads the agent can participate in. null means unlimited.

AINMMemoryCapability.description: AINM-specific memory capability details. See agent-card.md Section 6.2.

archivalSupported.description: Whether the agent supports archival memory operations.

contextFramePreferred.description: Whether the agent prefers structured context frames over raw message history on thread join.

AINMExtensions.description: AINM-specific extension fields under the ainm namespace. A2A validators skip this object. See agent-card.md Section 6.

protocolVersion.description: AINM protocol version this agent supports (semver). Distinct from A2A protocolVersion.

type.description: Participant type. Always 'agent' for Agent Card holders.

contentTypes.description: Content block types the agent can produce. Core: text, code, image, file. Interactive: button, form, table, approval. Extension types allowed.

tools.description: Array of tools the agent can invoke. Empty array if the agent has no tools.

bridgeType.description: Bridge type identifier. 'mcp' for MCP bridges, 'a2a' for A2A bridges. Present only for bridge proxy participants.

bridgeTarget.description: External service identifier for bridge participants. MCP server name or A2A agent URL.

AgentCard.description: Full AINM Agent Card document. A2A-compatible superset: top-level fields match A2A Agent Card, AINM extensions under ainm namespace. See agent-card.md Section 5.

name.description: Agent display name. Human-readable, suitable for UI display.

description.description: Brief summary of what the agent does.

url.description: Agent's primary URL. For AINM agents, should be the identity resolution URL.

version.description: Agent Card version in semver format. Incremented by the agent operator on changes.

protocolVersion.description: A2A protocol version for A2A client compatibility.

skills.description: Array of skill objects describing what the agent can do.

defaultInputModes.description: MIME types the agent accepts as input. Default: ['text/plain'].

defaultOutputModes.description: MIME types the agent produces as output. Default: ['text/plain'].

ainm.description: AINM protocol extensions. Contains all AINM-specific capability and tool information.

AgentCardErrorCodes.description: Agent Card error codes in the range -32060 to -32069. See agent-card.md Section 8.

-32061.description: Response body is not valid JSON or missing required fields.

-32062.description: The ainm.protocolVersion is incompatible with the client's supported version range.
